L118: The Music Bank Chart is a 【45†record chart】 established in 1998 on the South Korean 【46†KBS】 television 【47†music program】 【39†Music Bank】. Every week during its live broadcast, the show gives an award for the best-performing 【48†single】 on the South Korean chart.
L119: The chart utilizes digital performances on domestic online music services (60%), number of times the single was broadcast on KBS TV, radio and digital channels (20%), global pre-vote derived from Mubeat app (10%), album sales (5%), and social media score calculated using 【49†YouTube】 and 【50†TikTok】 data gathered from the 【51†Circle】 chart (5%) in its ranking methodology.^{【52†[1]】}^{【53†[2]】} The score for domestic online music services is calculated using data from 【54†Melon】, Bugs, 【55†Genie Music】, 【56†Naver Vibe】 and Flo.^{【57†[3]】} Actor 【58†Lee Chae-min】 and 【59†Le Sserafim】 member Hong Eun-chae had been hosting the show since September 30, 2022, and February 10, 2023, respectively.^{【60†[4]】}^{【61†[5]】} Chae-min went on to leave the show on May 3, 2024, after hosting the show for 1 year and 7 months.^{【62†[6]】}
L120: In 2024, 46 singles reached number one on the chart and 33 acts were awarded a first-place trophy.
